instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep what the person changed in words an AI wrote for them, so their voice is learned from it", and give it before; after.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:keep-a-voice-edit and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Run when the person themselves changed words an AI wrote (a draft's caption): kind (like post), subject_id (what was edited), before (the AI's words), after (theirs) and before_by (the AI that wrote them).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: voice-edit (records:list, records:write).
